bio: Just a short walk from the Fleckalmbahn cable car, Minglers Sportalm hotel boasts tastefully decorated guestrooms, a spa and this charming little restaurant with just four tables. The dining space is done out in light, warm wood from floor to ceiling, which makes for a cosy setting. The kitchen team conjures up a set menu that draws on modern culinary trends – you are free to choose the number of courses. You will be skilfully looked after by your host, including good wine recommendations from a predominantly Austrian list....
